dimensions.name: Objective clarity
dimensions.recommendation: State what decision the eval informs and what system behavior is being tested.

dimensions.name: Dataset design
dimensions.recommendation: Describe golden examples, edge cases, labels, and representative coverage.

dimensions.name: Metric coverage
dimensions.recommendation: Define product, quality, safety, latency, and cost metrics.

dimensions.name: Thresholds
dimensions.recommendation: Add explicit pass/fail thresholds and launch blocking criteria.

dimensions.name: Monitoring loop
